title: PROSECUTORS QUOTA ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Quota of Public Prosecutors)
The quota of public prosecutors under Article 36 (1) of the Prosecutors' Office Act shall be 2,292 persons. <Amended by Act No. 12952, Dec. 31, 2014>

Article 2 (Allocation of Public Prosecutor Quota to Each Prosecutors' Office)
The allocation of the public prosecutor quota under Article 1 to each prosecutors' office shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 8716, Dec. 21, 2007>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, of the total increase of 275 prosecutor positions, comprising the 140 positions not yet brought into effect at the time this Act enters into force out of the increase of 220 positions under Act No. 7733, the Act Partially Amending the Prosecutors Quota Act, together with the 135 positions added under this Act, the increase of 85 positions shall take effect on January 1, 2008, the increase of 95 positions on January 1, 2009, and the increase of 95 positions on January 1, 2010.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 12952, Dec. 31, 2014>
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among the 350 prosecutors that are increased under this Act, 90 out of the increased quota shall be effective from January 1, 2015; 80, from January 1, 2016; 70, from January 1, 2017; 70, from January 1, 2018; and 40, from January 1, 2019.
